parameters.query: SELECT id, client_id, identity, ideology, themes, banned_words, banned_topics, address_form, voice_examples, reference_prompt, max_chars, daily_tweet_count, updated_at FROM personas WHERE client_id = '{{ $json.client_id }}' LIMIT 1;

parameters.jsCode:
// Persona upsert SQL oluştur
const esc = (s) => s == null ? 'NULL' : `'${String(s).replace(/'/g, "''")}'`;
const escArr = (arr) => arr && arr.length ? `ARRAY[${arr.map(esc).join(',')}]::text[]` : `'{}'::text[]`;
const escJson = (v) => v == null ? "'[]'::jsonb" : `'${JSON.stringify(v).replace(/'/g, "''")}' ::jsonb`;

const d = $input.first().json;

const sql = `INSERT INTO personas
  (client_id, identity, ideology, themes, banned_words, banned_topics,
   address_form, voice_examples, reference_prompt, max_chars, daily_tweet_count)
VALUES
  (${esc(d.client_id)}, ${esc(d.identity)}, ${esc(d.ideology ?? 'conservative')},
   ${escArr(d.themes)}, ${escArr(d.banned_words)}, ${escArr(d.banned_topics)},
   ${esc(d.address_form)}, ${escJson(d.voice_examples)}, ${esc(d.reference_prompt)},
   ${d.max_chars ?? 280}, ${d.daily_tweet_count ?? 3})
ON CONFLICT (client_id) DO UPDATE SET
  identity          = EXCLUDED.identity,
  ideology          = EXCLUDED.ideology,
  themes            = EXCLUDED.themes,
  banned_words      = EXCLUDED.banned_words,
  banned_topics     = EXCLUDED.banned_topics,
  address_form      = EXCLUDED.address_form,
  voice_examples    = EXCLUDED.voice_examples,
  reference_prompt  = EXCLUDED.reference_prompt,
  max_chars         = EXCLUDED.max_chars,
  daily_tweet_count = EXCLUDED.daily_tweet_count,
  updated_at        = now()
RETURNING id, client_id, updated_at;`;

return [{ json: { sql } }];
